title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of Baxter Group Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of Baxter Group Ltd
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the area of overlap was minimal and therefore no competition concerns were likely to arise.
